diagnostic_tail: Dopamine cluster publisher error: Dopamine cluster draft rejected: The documented A12/A13 compatibility information is incomplete. The source facts state that the 3.x README lists both iOS 15.0–18.7.1 and iOS 26.0–26.0.1 for A12/A13 devices, but the article omits the iOS 26.0–26.0.1 range throughout its compatibility section, FAQ, key takeaways, and summary.; Because the article presents its A12/A13 bullets and prose as the documented compatibility ranges, omitting the separately listed iOS 26 range makes the compatibility overview misleading and incomplete.
